prompt: Rank these compounds by boiling point (lowest → highest). They have similar molecular weights (~70-75 g/mol).
explanation: Pentane (36 °C): only London dispersion. Diethyl ether (35 °C — nearly same as pentane): dipole-dipole but no H-bonding. 1-butanol (118 °C): H-bonding adds ~5 kcal/mol per bond → dramatically higher BP. H-bond donors + acceptors boil way above non-donors.
